QuestionStmt.S: Which of the following compound is used for preparation of quicklime?

Solution.S:
Quicklime (CaO) is prepared by heating calcium carbonate (limestone) strongly.

Reaction: $$\mathrm{CaCO_3 \xrightarrow{\Delta} CaO + CO_2}$$

Thus calcium carbonate decomposes on heating to give calcium oxide (quicklime) and carbon dioxide. Hence the correct option is C: Calcium carbonate.
